test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Make'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** context of the sentence** suggests an action that needs to be taken to hold bankers accountable for losses.
 
• The verb **'make'** best fits this context, as it used to indicate establishing someone into a certain role or duty.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'**Gaming in the banking sector seems virtually impossible to eliminate. The only effective measure to end it would be to **make **bankers personally liable for losses, to remove the sense that their actions - their games – have (3) ______ personal financial or legal consequences. It is this, rather (4) ______ removing the cap on bankers' bonuses, that has the best chance of preventing the financial system blowing (5) ______ again.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Option 1', **'gave' **is grammatically incorrect in this context. It might make sense in a context where something is being given or provided, but it is incorrect here.
 
• 'Option 2',** 'bake'** refers to cooking food by dry heat without direct exposure to a flame, typically in an oven or on a hot surface. It doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• 'Option 3',** 'take' **implies receiving or accepting something. It is inappropriate in this context where we are describing the act of establishing accountability.
